from fractions import Fraction as F
from decimal import Decimal as D, getcontext
from random import Random
from functools import reduce
import json
getcontext().prec=70
checks=[]
def rec(name, **details): checks.append(dict(name=name,passed=True,**details))
def prod(xs): return reduce(lambda a,b:a*b,xs,F(1))
rng=Random(77031)
for case in range(100):
    n=rng.randint(1,15); x=F(rng.randint(-10,10),7); xhat=x+F(rng.randint(-3,3),11);d0=xhat-x
    rho=[];eps=[]
    for k in range(n):
        a=F(rng.randint(-15,15),10); ah=a+F(rng.randint(-3,3),37)
        b=F(rng.randint(-7,7),9); bh=b+F(rng.randint(-3,3),41)
        d=xhat-x;local=(ah-a)*x+bh-b
        xnew=a*x+b;xhnew=ah*xhat+bh
        assert xhnew-xnew==ah*d+local
        x,xhat=xnew,xhnew;rho.append(abs(ah));eps.append(abs(local))
        bound=prod(rho)*abs(d0)+sum(e*prod(rho[j+1:]) for j,e in enumerate(eps))
        assert abs(xhat-x)<=bound
rec('exact_affine_local_identity_and_finite_product_bound',cases=100,includes_noncontracting_and_negative_coefficients=True)
rho=F(3,4);eps=F(1,100);d0=F(2,7);d=d0
for n in range(1,51):
    d=rho*d+eps
    assert d==rho**n*d0+eps*(1-rho**n)/(1-rho)
rec('uniform_contraction_geometric_bound_attained',prefixes=50)
# Exact finite nonnegative kernels, with support zeros; common initial measure.
def adv(mu,K): return [sum(mu[i]*K[i][j] for i in range(3)) for j in range(3)]
for case in range(80):
    mu=[F(1,5),F(0),F(4,5)];mh=mu[:];low=F(1);high=F(1)
    for k in range(8):
        K=[[F(rng.randint(0,8),9) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
        for i in range(3): K[i][i]+=F(1,9)
        lo=F(rng.randint(1,5),7); hi=lo+F(rng.randint(0,8),7)
        Kh=[[v*(lo+(hi-lo)*F(rng.randint(0,10),10)) for v in row] for row in K]
        mu=adv(mu,K);mh=adv(mh,Kh);low*=lo;high*=hi
        assert all(low*a<=b<=high*a for a,b in zip(mu,mh))
        p=[v/sum(mu) for v in mu];ph=[v/sum(mh) for v in mh]
        assert all(a==0 and b==0 or low/high<=b/a<=high/low for a,b in zip(p,ph))
rec('exact_positive_kernel_unnormalized_and_normalized_composition',cases=80,prefixes_per_case=8,support_zeros=True,log_width_equivalent='exp(B)=product(upper_multipliers)/product(lower_multipliers)')
K=[[F(2),F(1),F(0)],[F(0),F(1),F(4)],[F(3),F(0),F(1)]]
mu=[F(1,2),F(1,3),F(1,6)];m=mu[:];mh=mu[:];scale=F(1)
for c in [F(2),F(1,3),F(7,2)]:
    m=adv(m,K);mh=adv(mh,[[c*v for v in row] for row in K]);scale*=c
assert mh==[scale*v for v in m]
assert [v/sum(mh) for v in mh]==[v/sum(m) for v in m]
rec('state_independent_kernel_scale_cancels_exactly',unnormalized_scale=str(scale))
# For any nonzero arbitrarily small eta, singleton {0} separates Dirac maps.
eta=F(1,10**12); exact_mass=1;approx_mass=0
assert eta>0 and approx_mass==0<exact_mass
rec('small_deterministic_state_error_does_not_imply_multiplicative_measure_bound',state_distance=str(eta),separating_set='{0}',exact_mass=1,approximate_mass=0)
# Equal final parameters, differing chronological RC and capacity path.
def rc_path(segments):
    v=D('0.1')
    for R,tau,I,dt in segments:
        E=(-dt/tau).exp();v=E*v+R*I*(1-E)
    return v
seg_a=[tuple(map(D,s)) for s in [('1','1','1','1'),('2','1','1','1')]]
seg_b=[tuple(map(D,s)) for s in [('2','1','1','1'),('2','1','1','1')]]
a=rc_path(seg_a);b=rc_path(seg_b)
expected=(-D(1)).exp()*(1-(-D(1)).exp())
assert abs((b-a)-expected)<D('1e-65')
qa=[F(2),F(2),F(1)];qb=[F(2),F(1),F(1)]
za=sum(F(1,10)/q for q in qa);zb=sum(F(1,10)/q for q in qb)
assert za==F(1,5) and zb==F(1,4)
rec('equal_final_health_does_not_determine_path_transport',RC_endpoint_gap=str(b-a),SOC_decrements=[str(za),str(zb)],SOC_paths_same_initial_and_final_Q=True)
# Smooth q=Cv differentiation, with I=0,R=1,C=exp(-t):
# charge law v=exp(t+1-exp(t)); continuous-voltage law v=exp(1-exp(t)).
t=D('0.4');C=(-t).exp();v=(t+1-t.exp()).exp();vprime=(1-t.exp())*v
rhs=-v/C+v
assert abs(vprime-rhs)<D('1e-65')
C0,C1,v0=F(2),F(1),F(1,5);vcharge=C0/C1*v0
assert C1*vcharge==C0*v0 and vcharge!=v0
rec('charge_state_derivative_and_capacity_jump_convention',smooth_zero_current_voltage_ratio=str(t.exp()),charge_preserving_jump_voltage=str(vcharge),voltage_preserving_jump_voltage=str(v0))
assert F(2)*F(3,4)>1 and F(2)*F(1,4)<1
rec('increasing_R_decreasing_C_allows_tau_either_direction',tau_ratios=['3/2','1/2'])
eps=D('0.01');labels=[]
for n in (1,100,1000,10000):
    logodds=D(n)*eps;p=1/(1+(-logodds).exp())
    assert p>D('0.5')
    labels.append(dict(observations=n,exact_label1_probability='0.5',approximate_label1_probability=str(p),log_odds=str(logodds),physical_state=str(D('0.5')**n)))
rec('coherent_two_label_likelihood_defect_with_contracting_state',epsilon=str(eps),witnesses=labels)
print(json.dumps(checks,indent=2))
